title.en: To the Tune Shuidiao Getou: How Long Has the Bright Moon Been There

edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource; the variant readings it marks are left out. Lines broken at the punctuation for reading; text unchanged.
edition.zh: 据维基文库，删去其所注异文。按标点分行，文字未改。

basis.en: Song dynasty lyric (ci); the author died in 1101.

note.en: Written at Mid-Autumn 1076 in Mizhou, when Su Shi had not seen his brother Ziyou, Su Zhe, for several years; his preface says he drank until dawn and wrote it thinking of him. It begins by borrowing Li Bai’s question to the moon and ends on one of the best-loved wishes in Chinese: that we live long, and share the same moonlight across a thousand li. Notice that the poet weighs the cold palace in the sky against the human world, and chooses the world.
note.zh: 1076 年中秋作于密州，当时苏轼已经几年没有见到弟弟子由（苏辙），词前小序说是欢饮达旦、大醉之后“兼怀子由”而作。开头借用李白问月，结尾是汉语里最受喜爱的祝愿之一：但愿人长久，千里共婵娟。留意他把天上的琼楼玉宇与人间放在一起掂量，最后选了人间。

excerpt.orig: 但願人長久，千里共嬋娟。
excerpt.en: I only wish that we may both live long / and share, a thousand li apart, the beauty of the moon.
excerpt.zh: 但愿人长久，千里共婵娟。

gloss.en: The year Bingchen, 1076, when Su Shi was prefect of Mizhou and had not seen his brother for several years.
gloss.zh: 丙辰：宋神宗熙宁九年（1076），苏轼时任密州知州，与弟弟已多年未见。

gloss.en: Ziyou, the courtesy name of Su Shi’s younger brother, Su Zhe (1039–1112).
gloss.zh: 子由：苏轼的弟弟苏辙（1039–1112）的字。

gloss.en: To ride the wind and go back, as though he had come down from heaven.
gloss.zh: 乘风回到天上去，好像自己本是天上的人。

gloss.en: Towers of jade and halls of fine stone: the palaces of the moon.
gloss.zh: 琼楼玉宇：美玉砌成的楼宇，指月中宫殿。

gloss.en: Lovely, graceful; here, the moon itself.
gloss.zh: 婵娟：美好的样子，这里指明月。

note.en: A drunken question to the moon that ends by choosing the human world; Hu Zi wrote that after it, all other Mid-Autumn lyrics could be set aside.
note.zh: 醉中问月，最后选择了人间；胡仔说：“中秋词，自东坡《水调歌头》一出，余词尽废。”
